outcome: Measure task_44 and task_329 with three models through the OpenCode host on the source that closed the MADR 0010 gap (d7a7eb5): qwen/qwen3.5-35b-a3b and anthropic/claude-opus-5 against their rounds on eed47b7, and openai/gpt-5.6-luna as a first round of a cheap strong-family model
criteria: The image is rebuilt from d7a7eb5 and its ID recorded; each of the three models runs each task three times sequentially with informed framing and the runner's defaults, and the eighteen runs are retained as new directories under runs/<task>/ named by model, leaving earlier rounds untouched

The DataSpace README gains a section, newest first, with a per-model per-task table (official verdict, mean steps and calls, prompt tokens including cache reads, refusals, unadvised refusals, repair rate, elapsed, and cost per run and per pass at the gateway's list prices), comparison rows for qwen and opus against the third and fourth rounds on eed47b7, a per-run table, the commands, and what eighteen runs can and cannot establish
No backend, prompt, runner, host or evaluator code changes; the model is swapped only through the environment for these commands

note: Image rebuilt from d7a7eb5 (sha256:ed49111a...) and its ID recorded; eighteen runs retained under runs/<task>/opencode-informed-<model>-20260910-1245 for qwen3.5-35b-a3b, claude-opus-5 and gpt-5.6-luna. Verdicts: qwen 2/3 and 0/3, opus 3/3 and 3/3, gpt-5.6-luna 2/3 and 0/3. With prompt and tooling unchanged, qwen's task_44 refusals fell 13 to 5 and unadvised 8 to 1, steps 26.3 to 19.0, cost per run down about 38%; opus within noise of its fourth round; gpt-5.6-luna takes about eleven steps with no language refusals and fails only on the reading (the day key carried), at a thirtieth of opus's cost per run. Two backend findings recorded for the next outcome: parallel tool calls from gpt-5.6-luna hit the shared SQLite connection (one INTERNAL InterfaceError), and a derive with a name and no expression is the one unadvised refusal of the round. README section with per-model, per-run and cost tables at gateway list prices, the commands, and limits. No code changed.
